# Est8Go — Nigeria's Property Trust Infrastructure

## What is Est8Go?
Est8Go is Nigeria's first property trust verification platform. We verify that
properties are real before buyers spend money.

Every listing on Est8Go is:
- GPS verified on-site
- Photo intelligence audited
- Document checked (C of O, Survey Plan, Deed)
- Witness confirmed

## Trust Score System
Properties are scored 0-100:
- Emerald (85-100): Maximum verification
- Gold (70-84): GPS + key documents
- Silver (50-69): GPS verified, partial docs
- Bronze (0-49): Basic verification

## Platform URLs

### Main Platform
- Website: https://est8go.com
- API: https://api.est8go.com
- Embed documentation: https://api.est8go.com/public/embed

### Verified Agency Partners
Each agency has a dedicated verified vault page:
- Bravieshomz Limited: https://api.est8go.com/public/bravieshomz-limited

### Property Pages
Individual verified properties:
- Format: https://api.est8go.com/public/property/{id}
- Example: https://api.est8go.com/public/property/4

### Machine-readable data
- Sitemap: https://api.est8go.com/sitemap.xml
- Listings API: https://api.est8go.com/public/api/{tenant-slug}/listings

## Services
1. WhatsApp Sales Engine (Kora) — 24/7 lead qualification
2. GPS Verification — on-site coordinate capture
3. Photo Intelligence Audit — authenticity checking
4. Document Verification — title document checking
5. Trust Certificate — downloadable PDF proof
6. Embed Widget — one script tag for any website
7. Drop-off Recovery — automated follow-up

## Target Market
- Nigerian real estate agencies
- Property buyers in Nigeria
- Diaspora buyers (UK, US, Canada)
- Property investors
